name: select-explainer
description: Highlight text, ask a question about it, and keep the answer pinned to the page - without growing the conversation you're reading.

scripts.test: node test/unit.mjs && node test/anchor.mjs && node test/restore.mjs && node test/attach.mjs && node test/orphan.mjs && node test/ui.mjs
scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -f select-explainer.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../select-explainer.zip . -x '_metadata/*' '.*' && cd .. && echo 'wrote select-explainer.zip'
scripts.package:raycast: rm -f select-explainer-raycast.zip && cd raycast && zip -qr ../select-explainer-raycast.zip package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json icon.png INSTALL.txt src && cd .. && echo 'wrote select-explainer-raycast.zip'
